curriculumAlignmentSummary: Unit 4 covers foundational concepts of data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning models, data visualization methods, and the data science life cycle. Past papers evaluate these topics via multiple-choice questions, brief exploratory short response questions, and analytical scenarios.
